messages:
ravi: opened PR to add Acadia-13B int8 model-card + catalog entry. includes limits, short migration checklist, and compact SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5123
sam: can you paste the bench numbers you used for the limits table (hw + seq/batch)?
kevin: ran on a100-80g (1x): p50 ~40ms @512 (batch=4), sustained ~150 tok/s @batch=8, resident ~42GB with int8 (Q4). gist: https://gist.github.com/kevin/acadia-5123
mahmoud: link-checker: migration note uses a relative path `../models/acadia` -> 404. switch to canonical `/models/acadia`.
link-bot: Link check failed: /docs/models/acadia -> 404
ravi: thanks — switching to `/models/acadia` and adding a redirect entry. also adding a short "Runtime compatibility" row.
sam: wording suggestion for the row: `Runtime < 3.1: int8 (KV v2) not supported. Requests will auto-fallback to Acadia-13B-fp16. Upgrade runtime to enable int8.` keep it terse.
kevin: also in limits table: `max sequence: 8192 (tested); recommended sustained <=4096 for predictable P50`. and replace generic "quantized" with "int8 (Q4)".
mahmoud: dropping snippets to paste into the PR — edit as needed:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
resp = c.embeddings.create(model="acadia-13b-int8", input=["a","b"], batch_size=6)
print([d.embedding for d in resp.data])
```
```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'acadia-13b-int8', input: ['a','b'], batchSize: 6 })
console.log(resp.data.map(d => d.embedding))
```
sam: nit: mention how to force fp16 for parity tests: `model: 'acadia-13b-fp16'` in examples.
ravi: added snippets, link fix, compatibility row, and short "known diffs" note about small output/tokenization variance when switching fp16<->int8. tagging reviewers @sam @kevin.
link-bot: PR updated, running checks (link-check, lint)
build-bot: docs build passed — staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/models/acadia (expires in 48h)
sam: LGTM, will review tomorrow morning. ravi: merge after my approval and ping #release-war-room when live :thumbsup:
